sentences.en: The last few decades have brought significant changes to evolutionary thought.
sentences.zh: 过去的几十年里，进化思想经历了显著的变化。

sentences.en: Evolutionary psychologists mostly focus on what makes us so much alike.
sentences.zh: 进化心理学家主要关注使我们如此相似的因素。

sentences.en: I'm fascinated by the evolutionary history of the louse.
sentences.zh: 我对虱子的进化历史非常着迷。

senses.zh: 进化论的，进化的；演变的，逐步发展的
